nodes.text: @j_smith58042 @LasVegasLocally Unfortunately it is under recognized. Please tell them two things-you are not getting better, you suspect you have metapneumovirus or maybe mycoplasma (that needs antibiotics), do a chest X-ray if indicated, you may need an oral cough suppressant and a spray for postnasal drip
